titleEn: In My Chair, Ready to Eat!

pages.text: Mom set a steaming pot on the long table. Three cousins sat in a row. But Lulu ran round the table holding bread.
"Lulu, it is mealtime!" Mom called. Lulu pretended not to hear and ran another lap. "Food tastes good while running too!"
Lulu came back. Only Lulu's bowl was empty. The cousins' bowls steamed.
One wooden chair stood empty. "There is your place, Lulu." Mom patted it. Lulu's ears pricked, eyes widening.
Mom carried the pot round the table, stopping before each seated cousin. She walked past Lulu's empty chair.
Lulu quickly sat firmly down. The pot stopped, and warm soup poured in. "In my chair, ready to eat!"
A wooden spoon rolled beneath the table. Lulu stayed firmly seated and waited. "In my chair, ready to eat!" Bite after bite, the soup was warm.
Lulu leaned over the bowl and raised both shoulders. Today was the first time the bowl was emptied to the bottom. The blue bell jingled.
Next evening, Lulu sat first with a straight back. "One, sit in my chair! Two, hold firmly with both hands! Three, get up after emptying the bowl!" The cousins sat too.
Mom stroked Lulu's back and kissed the cheek. Seated eating keeps soup warm. "Such a shiny-clean bowl! In my chair, ready to eat!"
